items.description: ] [pypi] OWASP runtime defense layer that screens agent memory writes for poisoning before they reach the agent — multi-layer validation with semantic anomaly detection, entropy scoring, provenance verification, and cross-reference and temporal checks.

items.title: inspeximus (formerly mnemo) poisoning probes [attack
items.description: ] [defense] Runnable probe scripts demonstrating that provenance written into a memory record is forgeable, and that a retrieval-time corroboration gate raises the cost of memory-poisoning attacks.
